issue.title: Shim version drift blocks review dispatch for bot-authored PRs on ci-failure-tracker

llm_context.input_title: Shim version drift blocks review dispatch for bot-authored PRs on ci-failure-tracker
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: Bot-authored PRs fail review dispatch because target repository shims are outdated (pinned to v0.30.0), lacking the 'labeled' trigger type needed to route ready-for-review events around permission limitations.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The repository's shim workflow is pinned to an older version (v0.30.0) whose `on.pull_request_target.types` omits `labeled` and lacks the route handler for `pull_request_target/labeled` events, which were introduced in subsequent versions to bypass bot collaborator permission API limitations.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect Event Router Control Flow
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect symbol HarnessRouter in internal/dispatch/router.go and verify how pull_request_target events and stage matching are structured.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect Authorization Gate
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect symbol IsAuthorized in internal/harnessdispatch/auth.go to understand how bot collaborator permissions and authorization gates are evaluated during dispatch.

step_by_step_plan.title: Update Shim Workflow Triggers
step_by_step_plan.description: Update the repository shim workflow configuration in .github/workflows/fullsend.yaml to include the 'labeled' trigger type for pull_request_target events.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add Regression Test Cases
step_by_step_plan.description: Add regression test cases in internal/dispatch/router_test.go and internal/harnessdispatch/auth_test.go to verify correct routing and authorization for pull_request_target/labeled events.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run Test Suite
step_by_step_plan.description: Run the test suite using go test to confirm that the changes pass successfully and fix the review dispatch issue for bot-authored PRs.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: The specific event types and activities (like pull_request_target with opened, synchronize, or labeled) that tell GitHub when to run a workflow file.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: If a workflow trigger type is missing from the YAML file, GitHub Actions will never fire the workflow for that specific event, preventing downstream routing logic from ever executing.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The outdated shim lacks the 'labeled' trigger type under pull_request_target, preventing ready-for-review label events from triggering the workflow.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Security checks that verify whether an event actor has sufficient repository permissions to trigger automated actions.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Bot accounts often lack standard write permissions in the collaborator API, requiring alternative routing paths (like label-added events) to authorize securely.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Bot-authored PRs fail the standard opened check because bots lack write-level collaborator access, necessitating the labeled event bypass.

common_pitfalls: Modifying internal routing logic when the issue is purely a downstream repository configuration/shim version drift.
Forgetting to include both 'labeled' and 'unlabeled' trigger types when updating templates.
